text: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE DOCUMENT. SYNTHETIC-Account-Juliett is described for development purposes only as operating placeholder infrastructure across two sites. Nothing in this document describes a real organization, a real project, or a real decision. Added by T-207 for the same reason as the Foxtrot note, and it is the account that belongs to both campaigns — so one stored fact has to serve two independent candidates without either borrowing the other's judgement.
